Methods, checks and limitations

Five machines, six steps; batch-compatible FIFO; two qualified operators; a shared maintenance technician; scheduled breaks and deferred preventive maintenance. An independent pilot selected warm-up and run length. Baseline load targets use calibrated occupied/available lithography utilization; productive utilization is separately recorded.

The source specification and reconstructed operational conventions are documented in MODEL.md in the downloadable project. Exact break placement, maintenance arbitration and interruption semantics are model choices. Published-output validation is reported in the project, and differences are not hidden. Optional disruption recovery, wet-clean constraints and alternate dispatch rules are outside this core study.

Sources: El-Khouly, 2015 · Factory Physics and simulation
